issuing_body: Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes
title: Minnesota Statutes Chapter 550 — Executions, Redemption, Exemptions
supports: Minn. Stat. § 550.01 authorizes a judgment creditor to enforce a judgment in the manner provided by law.
Minn. Stat. § 550.011 provides for disclosure of a judgment debtor's assets, liabilities, and earnings sufficient to permit satisfaction by execution on nonexempt assets and earnings.
Minn. Stat. § 550.135 authorizes sheriff levy on specified personal property, money, or indebtedness, subject to exemptions and procedural limits.
selected_locators: § 550.011 — judgment debtor disclosure and execution on nonexempt assets
§ 550.135, subds. 2-4 — levy on personal property, money, or indebtedness and exemptions
important_qualifications: Chapter 550 execution is subject to exemptions and other procedural requirements.
The existence of civil execution tools does not establish that any specific restitution creditor used or could successfully use them against a particular asset.
